annotations.title: Exterior painting weather and drying check

description: For a UK postcode (or latitude and longitude) and dates from today up to 8 days ahead, fetches the hourly forecast (MET Norway) and checks each working hour against typical limits for the paint type: minimum temperature, humidity, 3 C above dew point, rain chance, wind, and a rain-free drying time after each coat. Returns each day's verdict (good, good_but_watch_rain, marginal, no), the best painting window, the main problems and an indicative recoat time at that day's temperature. Pass the data sheet's own limits to override. Example: {"postcode":"LS1 4AP","paint_type":"water_based_masonry","start_date":"2026-11-14","end_date":"2026-11-18"}.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 15 days after today. Defaults to start + 6 days.

min_temp_c.description: Minimum application temperature from the data sheet.

paint_type.description: water_based_masonry: Water-based masonry paint, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 4 h rain free; solvent_based_masonry: Solvent-based (pliolite type) masonry paint, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 2 h rain free; water_based_trim: Water-based exterior gloss or satin for wood, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 3 h rain free; solvent_based_trim: Solvent-based (oil) exterior gloss or undercoat, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free; wood_stain_water: Water-based wood stain, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 4 h rain free; wood_stain_solvent: Solvent-based wood stain, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free; metal_paint: Solvent-based metal paint, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free

postcode.description: Full UK postcode of the job.

rain_free_hours.description: Hours the coat must stay dry after it goes on.

recoat_hours_at_20c.description: Recoat time at 20 C from the data sheet.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Defaults to today.

start_hour.description: Working day start, 24 hour clock. Defaults to 8.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Fresh Coat Decorators".

licence_body.description: Trade body or accreditation the business belongs to (pda = Painting and Decorating Association).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

name: exterior_weather_check
title: Exterior painting weather and drying check
